page.layout: One column of running text, with Greek and Latin in the same lines. No marginal notes. Running head at top right, page number at top left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: disciplinam nullo haberi loco, immo ἐωὶ λοιπασίας [illegible, ~8 letters] eorum praepediri, qui eius ἔργο- [illegible, ~9 letters] esse debebant: refrigescere zelum pro gloria Dei, pro tuenda veritate: [illegible, ~7 letters] charitatis exstinguis magistratus colludere cum laruatis praesulibus, cum idololatris: denique civitatem non ita multo ante fidelem, fieri meretricem. Intelligunt enim piae mentes, hac rerū Ecclesiasticarum ἀνατάραξις [?] & perturbatione in discrimen adduci, non tam corpora, ut fit politijs turbatis, quàm animas: & perniciosum hoc exemplum noxium esse huic aetati & toti posteritati.
Enimuerò qui istis omnibus non afficitur, is profectò cor habet durius Caucasi rupibus.

p.i: Quid igitur Dei seruus tantorumq; malorum [illegible, ~8 letters] faciat, cum nec iam natis malis sese mederi, nec etiam nascituris occurrere posse uidet?

main_text.p: Primum cogitet, hoc funestum spectaculum sibi esse commune cum Patribus, Prophetis, sanctis Iudicibus & Regibus, denique cum Christo, Apostolis & Martyribus: quibus omnibus cū is se meliorem non esse intelligat, ne meliorem in huius

page.notes: Several Greek words are heavily blurred and could not be read letter by letter: "ἐωὶ λοιπασίας", "ἔργο-" and the Greek word after "malorum" are doubtful. Marked illegible or with [?] rather than guessed. The Greek word after "perturbatione" is uncertain (ἀνατάραξις?). The page number is printed in an old-style figure and reads 52. The italic line "Quid igitur..." is set in italic with a Greek word inside; the Greek is uncertain. The word "huius" at the foot is a catchword and is also the first word of the page's last line, so it is kept only in the catchword element as the page ends mid-sentence. The last main-text paragraph ends with "huius" as a catchword, which is a printing feature. No marginal notes are visible on this page.
